subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI's visible history, and if so through what supported boundary?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but implementation depends on maintainer intent for third-party Open WebUI persistence ownership, direct SQLite/schema coupling versus API or adapter integration, opt-in configuration, and historical backfill behavior.

options.title: Design opt-in visible-history sync
options.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow Open WebUI sync contract with schema/version handling and live Docker/Open WebUI proof before implementation.

options.title: Route to plugin or adapter
options.body: Keep core lean by requiring this Open WebUI-specific mirror to live behind a plugin or integration boundary, adding only any missing core API seam if needed.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Decide that OpenClaw owns transcript and model context only for this workflow and document that Open WebUI visible history is not updated by Control UI sends.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in visible-history sync
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow Open WebUI sync contract with schema/version handling and live Docker/Open WebUI proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue needs a Gateway/session-store plus product-boundary decision, and steipete has the strongest nearby history across session store keys, inbound dispatch, webchat routing, and Open WebUI proof lanes.
